title: 印度AI风向突变：从基建卷向应用层，风投数据揭示反转
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: watched this India startup ecosystem for years.
segments.zh: 多年来，我一直在观察印度初创企业生态。

segments.en: How has the landscape changed in the past few years?
segments.zh: 过去几年，格局有何变化？

segments.en: And what have you seen in terms of investment opportunities, particularly in artificial intelligence?
segments.zh: 在**机会方面，特别是人工智能领域，您看到了什么？

segments.en: Well, I'll be here, Sherry, and thanks for the time.
Yeah. I think about maybe three to four years ago when AI companies began to come to us and show up in our V flow.
segments.zh: 大约三四年前，AI公司开始进入我们的视野。

segments.en: Maybe about 20% of the companies were AI. 80% was non AI.
And within the AI category, I would say maybe 80% were more of the infrastructure businesses.
segments.zh: 在AI类别中，约80%属于基础设施业务。

segments.en: We made an investment. We were a plus investor in Sarvam.
segments.zh: 我们进行了**，是Sarvam AI的追加市场参与者。

segments.en: We made an investment in a company called Composio.
segments.zh: 我们**了一家名为Composio的公司。

segments.en: We made an investment in a company called Podkey. We traditionally got acquired by Palo Alto and the US.
segments.zh: 我们还**了Podkey，后来被美国Palo Alto收购。

segments.en: So these were more infrastructure companies. They were kind of closer to the metal.
segments.zh: 这些是更接近底层的基础设施公司。

segments.en: And the last year or two, I think the ratio has flipped.
segments.zh: 过去一两年，这个比例已经反转了。

segments.en: A, from 20% of our e-flow in AI, three, four years back, now about 80%, 90% of our e-flow is AI.
segments.zh: 三四年前，我们AI相关的**占20%，现在大约80%到90%都是AI。

segments.en: So majority of the founders that come to us and knock on our doors are building something in or around AI.
segments.zh: 所以大多数来找我们的创业者都在构建AI相关的东西。

segments.en: And of that 80%. I mean, I would say, yeah.
